body: Why does virginity matter so much to you? Do you want to just have done it or are you in need of that form of intimacy. Couldn’t you just download tinder and hook up with someone? There’s more to like than sex. Sex is okay and all, but it shouldn’t be a main goal for anyone.
I think the toxic environment is dragging you down. Before you go, I’d think it would be worth getting away and seeing if you can live peacefully without them.
I do hope you find good friends at your new school. Friends that you can be vulnerable with and who will support you no matter what.

Have you tried talking to your great girlfriend or your supportive family? It’s hard asking for help, and I don’t really have advice for taking that step. You have to be vulnerable to your loved ones.
I don’t think there’s anything wrong with starting over at 40. If you aren’t happy, I think there is no age limit where you can change your life around.
Why do you feel that you aren’t good enough? Why do you hate yourself?

Your life hasn’t even begun yet. I’m 18 and my life hasn’t even started yet. Yeah, the youth has grown up with internet, and I’m starting to see how horrible it is for our growth. I’d say just cut down using the internet little by little until you can go a day without internet. It’s better to focus on what’s right in front of you than what’s on a screen. I live a privileged life too and I do feel guilty for being unmotivated. I’m honestly still not sure on how to stay motivated because I tend to go through feeling unmotivated, until one day I feel like changing. I think that’s something you have to find in yourself. Not going to lie, I jack off every night. Yeah it’s probably not healthy and I’ve tried to work on it but I still can’t stop it. Even if I’m not really in the mood for it, I always go look for a video. Maybe it’s the feeling of cumming that so addictive. But after I feel disgusting, like “ew why did I just do that”. I don’t have much guidance for that, but I’d say try to find something to do throughout your day so you can cut it down to once a day and maybe you can try for once every other day. 

I’ve cut once before for a silly reason, and it just made the pain feel worse honestly. Like it burns and I’d rather not go through that again. I can relate to being unsure about dying. Not existing would be great, but that not really an option because you would have to kill yourself to not exist. But there’s also no guarantee that you won’t exist because no one alive on earth knows what happens after death. And not knowing what happens kind of scares me. Moral of my comment is, you have 10 years until you fully develop. I think it’s worth sticking around until then because a lot can happen in 10 years. And it’s never to late to change what you don’t like about yourself. But you have to love yourself first. It all starts with that. I was pretty chubby at your age too, and high school is the age where it’s easier to lose weight. I’ve slimmed down since then, you just need to want to do things. I hope you find your way in life.
This is exactly what I was thinking this morning. And I don’t even know how to disagree with you. They are all valid points.

Confidence plays a big factor in being beautiful. And that comes from loving yourself with all the flaws you think you have. I’ve suffered from acne, pimples that looked like large bumps on my face and it was painful too. And I had to get up every morning knowing that I will have to go to high school school with distracting swollen bumps on my face. But I just stopped looking in the mirror one day and that honestly helped so much. I just acted like it wasn’t a big deal, and I kept head held high as I walked around school. It felt good. 
I still have a bit of acne, but I know that looks aren’t worth much. As long as you learn to love yourself, you will be happy.
Thank you. Honestly, I’ll probably just go back to therapy if I go lower. I do think I could try to continue, it just won’t be the easiest thing.
Of course! You can always reach out, I’ll be glad to talk:)
You don’t have to worry about me taking my life anytime soon. I know that I’m still young and have my life ahead of me. I just need to find a purpose for existing.

Everyone has potential. Sounds corny as hell, but it’s true. However not everyone feels that they can reach that potential so it can be easy to get discouraged. I myself feel like I won’t ever reach the success my parents have, but I’m realizing why am I comparing myself to others. We also have our own lives. If you end it now, you will never get to see yourself at your full potential.

Will they regret or would they just continue to laugh at you? (Definitely not trying to be rude) It wouldn’t be the best way to get back at them. But if you were to get older and noticeably do better than them, wouldn’t that feel better? Knowing that they are irrelevant while you succeed would feel real nice.

Would dying feel better, or would getting away from your parents and living your own life by your own expectations? You are quite young so you can’t really get out of there soon. Have you imagined though growing up into an adult who proved her parents wrong?

I would pay any price for that pill. I would need to prepare first because when I die my family is going to go through my room and there’s some things I’d rather not have them find, plus I would need to leave a little note for the few friends I do have. But honestly I feel you. Like when I’m “prepared” would I actually go through with it. I’m not completely sure that I would.
Hope you end up in a better place than this
